summary: Ohmyhome Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of Nasdaq confirmation that it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq's July 13, 2026 notification letter had flagged a minimum bid price deficiency, granting 180 calendar days, or until January 11, 2027, to cure. On September 15, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed the Class A ordinary shares closed at $1.00 or above for 10 consecutive business days from August 31 through September 14, 2026, closing the matter. A press release was issued September 17, 2026. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure and any reverse-split proposal.
